Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

content:
-- =============================================================================
-- Author:              chengguo.liu@shopee.com
-- Created Time:        2025-12-04
-- Theme Domain:        Customer Stability Check Backtesting
-- Data Granularity:    
-- Description:         GPS location distance calculation and scoring for KTP backtesting
--                      Calculate haversine distance between user GPS and KTP registered address
--                      Generate distance score (1-7) based on distance threshold
-- Documents:           
-- =============================================================================
--  Version History:
--  2025-12-04 - chengguo.liu - 修复 gps backtesting逻辑 - Jira: https://jira.shopee.io/browse/SPFDT-58191
--  2026-04-01 taowei 新增 id  方便后续读表按照 id 排序传文件 https://jira.shopee.io/browse/SPFDT-62032
-- =============================================================================


-- drop table if exists ${SCHEMA}.ads_risk_${region}_gps_ktp_phone_backtesting_info_rt;
create external table if not exists ${SCHEMA}.ads_risk_${region}_gps_ktp_phone_backtesting_info_rt
(
    backtest_date string comment 'backtesting date'
    ,id_type string comment 'id type'
    ,id_no string comment 'id number'
    ,phone_no string comment 'phone number'
    ,name string comment 'user name'
    ,dob string comment 'date of birth'
    ,gps string comment 'gps coordinates'
    ,distance_score int comment 'distance score between gps and registered address (1-7)'
    ,confidence_level string comment 'address confidence level'
    ,id bigint comment ''
)
comment 'Tag:GPS KTP Phone Backtesting Info'
partitioned by
(
    grass_date string comment 'partition key, yyyy-MM-dd'
    ,task_id string comment 'task_id'
)
stored as orc tblproperties ("orc.compress"="zstd")
location '${HDFS_PATH}/risk_feature/ads/ads_risk_reg_gps_ktp_phone_backtesting_info_rt/grass_region=${grass_region}';
-- msck repair table ${SCHEMA}.ads_risk_${region}_gps_ktp_phone_backtesting_info_rt;

uncache table if exists t_backtesting_task_id_list;
cache table t_backtesting_task_id_list options ('storageLevel' 'MEMORY_AND_DISK')
as
select
    t1.task_id
    ,t2.id
    ,t1.task_status
    ,t1.hash_method
    ,get_json_object(t2.task_data, '$.id_type') as id_type
    ,get_json_object(t2.task_data, '$.id_no') as id_no
    ,get_json_object(t2.task_data, '$.msisdn') as phone_no
    ,get_json_object(t2.task_data, '$.name') as name
    ,get_json_object(t2.task_data, '$.dob') as dob
    ,get_json_object(t2.task_data, '$.backtest_date') as backtest_date
    ,get_json_object(t2.task_data, '$.gps') as gps
    ,cast(split(regexp_replace(get_json_object(t2.task_data, '$.gps'), '[()]', ''), ',')[0] as double) as gps_x
    ,cast(split(regexp_replace(get_json_object(t2.task_data, '$.gps'), '[()]', ''), ',')[1] as double) as gps_y
from
(
    select
        task_id
        ,task_status
        ,lower(hash_method) as hash_method
    from risk.view__credit_risk_open_platform_ph_db__auto_backtesting_task_tab__spark
    where task_status = 5
    and service_name_list = 'CustomerStabilityCheck'
) t1
left join
(
    select
        task_id
        ,task_data
        ,id
    from risk.view__credit_risk_open_platform_ph_db__auto_backtesting_task_data_tab__spark
) t2
on t1.task_id = t2.task_id
left join
(
    select
        task_id
    from ${SCHEMA}.ads_risk_${region}_gps_ktp_phone_backtesting_info_rt
    where grass_date = '${ds}'
    group by task_id
) t3
on t1.task_id = t3.task_id
where t3.task_id is null
;

uncache table if exists t_backtesting_backtest_date_list;
cache table t_backtesting_backtest_date_list options ('storageLevel' 'MEMORY_AND_DISK')
as
select
    backtest_date
from t_backtesting_task_id_list
group by backtest_date
;

create or replace temporary view t_backtesting_task_result as
select  task_id
        ,id
        ,backtest_date
        ,id_type
        ,id_no
        ,phone_no
        ,name
        ,dob
        ,gps
        ,case   when distance <= 0.25 then 7
                when distance > 0.25 and distance <= 0.5 then 6
                when distance > 0.5 and distance <= 1 then 5
                when distance > 1 and distance <= 2 then 4
                when distance > 2 and distance <= 3 then 3
                when distance > 3 and distance <= 5 then 2
                when distance > 5 then 1
                else 0 end as distance_score
        ,case   when distance is null then null
                else confidence_level end as confidence_level
from
(
    select task_id
        ,id
        ,id_type
        ,id_no
        ,phone_no
        ,name
        ,dob
        ,backtest_date
        ,gps
        ,distance
        ,confidence_level
    from (

        from (
            select task_id
                    ,id
                    ,id_type
                    ,id_no
                    ,phone_no
                    ,name
                    ,dob
                    ,backtest_date
                    ,gps
                    ,2 * 6371 * asin(
                        sqrt(
                            pow(sin(radians((gps_x - address_x) / 2)), 2) 
                            + cos(radians(gps_x)) * cos(radians(address_x)) 
                            * pow(sin(radians((gps_y - address_y) / 2)), 2)
                        )
                    ) as distance
                    ,confidence_level
            from (
                select task_id

                        ,id_type
                        ,id_no
                        ,phone_no
                        ,name
                        ,dob
                        ,backtest_date
                        ,gps

                        ,cast(split(regexp_replace(item.address,'[()]', ''), ',')[0] as double) as address_x
                        ,cast(split(regexp_replace(item.address,'[()]', ''), ',')[1] as double) as address_y

                            ,t1.backtest_date

                        from t_backtesting_task_id_list t1
                        left join
                        (

                                    ,id_no_sha256
                                    ,id_no_base64
                                    ,address_info
                                    ,grass_date
                            from risk.ads_2bscore_ph_user_kyc_info_df

                        left join
